cyclone.author: Keith Ewers / LFIAA

gibbon.author: Howard Gibbon / East–West Publications

Photographs show Gibbon’s teaching material, not Chee Soo in the 1970s.

interview.accessNote: The search reader supplied the two-page PDF text, but a direct fetch returned HTTP 404 on 24 October 2026.

lute.author: Keith Ewers / LFIAA

pearson.author: Carl Pearson

pluck.author: Keith Ewers / LFIAA

stork.author: Keith Ewers / LFIAA
